UP Home Guard Final Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has released the UP Home Guard Final Result 2026 on its official website. This recruitment was released for 41,424 posts. The applications for UP Home Guard Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 18 November 2025 to 17 December 2025. The PET / PST examination was conducted from 14 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UP Home Guard Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 18 November 2025
  • Application Start Date : 18 November 2025
  • Last Date : 17 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 December 2025
  • Correction Date : 18-21 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 25, 26 & 27 April 2026
  • Exam City Details : 18 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 22 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 07 May 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 28 June 2026
  • Result : 28 June 2026
  • DV / PST Exam : 13 July 2026
  • DV / PST Admit Card : 06 July 2026
  • PST Exam Date : 16 September 2026
  • PET New Exam Date : 15 September 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 13 September 2026
  • FInal Result : 03 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 300/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
